headline: St. Thomas Aquinas end the season unbeaten by any member
dek: St. Thomas Aquinas finished the season as they began it, beaten by Southern New Hampshire. All five of their defeats came against programmes from outside the conference; among members, only D'Youville and Molloy took a point off them.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals have not ordered the table: Queens have outscored every programme except Mercy, and that includes the leaders, St. Thomas Aquinas.

wire.line: Mercy have outscored every other side in the conference and still have not beaten St. Thomas Aquinas.
